review_method: Independent static runner/source reading, AST parsing and exact file hashes only. The reviewer did not import or execute the runner, Main production modules, credential consumers, models or API transport.

actual_adapter_and_stage_path_review.Main_dispatch: GenerationService.generate enhanced interactive request -> checked.generate_checked, using the supplied actual teacher RoleAdapter and checker RoleAdapter.
actual_adapter_and_stage_path_review.scope_qualification: Main may perform its existing lawful local draft/schema normalization. The manifest no-repair phrase means no additional paid repair POST, not proof that raw model text and final outcome are identical.

finite_transport_and_cost_review.attempt_count_interpretation: A conservative before-transport attempt/reservation count; failures before a physical send must not be reported as proven completed provider POSTs.
finite_transport_and_cost_review.conservative_input_bound: Actual UTF-8 body bytes plus 1024 protocol allowance; explicitly not measured input tokens.
finite_transport_and_cost_review.qualification: This is static enforcement of the declared request/rate/token envelope, not an independent current-price lookup or advance invoice guarantee. Preserve actual reported costs, failures and UNKNOWN dispositions. The reviewer does not grant or expand execution authorization.

raw_retention_and_conditional_contract_r.diagnostic_copy_optional_parse_qualifica: The helper may inspect sanitized UTF-8/JSON while forming its artifact. Persistence is before the Main provider/business decoder receives the unchanged raw bytes; it is not a claim that no diagnostic parse happens first.
raw_retention_and_conditional_contract_r.ordinary_attempt_contract: A fresh user_question with no attempt metadata permits Main's guarded missing attempt_evaluation_ok -> not_applicable normalization only when its actual server predicate is true.

retrieval_and_teacher_context_reporting.qualification: Raw top5 input, complementary packed teacher ranges, actual transmitted evidence and checker-selected support are separate denominators. Five inputs do not establish that every full chunk or every frozen fragment is transmitted. Preserve normal packing/renumbering and actual source ranges.

credential_and_native_scope_review.previous_use_fact: Root reports this exact b19f consumer was formally approved and used by successful actual checker05A; this review does not rerun that consumer.
credential_and_native_scope_review.Main_public_consumer_CODE_AST_extract: The unchanged approved consumer reads Main model_settings/service.py and extracts resolve_secret/PREFIX; this is code reuse, not an additional opaque metadata reader.
credential_and_native_scope_review.qualification: Static source identity/scope review does not prove current key-file content, DB binding or decrypt success. Those actions remain inside Root's concrete formally reviewed consumer execution; no new native protected-field permission is granted.

time_and_result_interpretation.measured_component_interval: Immediately before GenerationService.generate to its final return, including teacher+checker when both run; excludes earlier credential/context preparation and later outer outcome-save.
time_and_result_interpretation.required_question_content: Relative stability of internal conditions; optional feedback/examples require support if asserted.

history_preservation: Initial08/preflight source-binding gap and zero-call outputs remain unchanged. Corrected08d uses fresh output directories. The first reviewer assertion failure (Windows separator assumption) is preserved; correction changes only review assertions, not runner, manifest or source.
next_validation: Root's exact approved execution and independent after-run source/predicate/cost/NA review. Static PASS is not a paid-run result.
